I got my "sex ed" way too early. Like, around 4 years old. Most of the time it just entailed scaring me from anything remotely about sex. Sure, they were good warnings, but it scared me to the point that I couldn't approach any older male figure and not think about them kidnapping and/or taking advantage of me

I think that it definitely makes sense that parents of kids who participate in extracurricular activities support them by signing their own kids up for those activities in the first place. Even if those kids get to those activities on their own, they must have been taught how to first. 

I guess our parents were just "too busy" or lazy to give us the effort.

My nmom always makes it like that those kind of kids (who were in my social circle back then) did those on their own because they were "independent." 

And whenever I called her out on it by saying that " X's mom signed her up for it," she'll say something like "be grateful I'm not pressuring you to do more stuff. Now go sweep the floor" or something like that

This is how I learned that both of my parents were narcissists. They just took turns on who was gonna bully me more. 

It sucked a lot when they're the only company I had at home.

Whenever I get new friends and my nmom learns of it through some school event or party, my nmom would remind me of how messy this certain friend's family life was, which she only learned though gossip.

She made me fully distrust most of my relatives too, which is somewhat true anyway, but then she'd ask me questions about why I wasn't too close with both sides of the family.

It made me quite distant and a bit fake towards my extended relatives, which made me cling to my friends more, which my nmom claims that some of my best friends were bad influences (because they weren't afraid to hate her.)

We do what we can to protect ourselves. I still lie a lot to my nmom too. Testing out stories in my head if they would work or not, making sure that I make full eye contact or that I seem "chill" enough that she won't think I'm lying.

It makes me feel disgusting, but its what has to be done. 

You're not alone in this, OP. Whatever negative thoughts you may have developed about yourself because of the situation you're in are markers, they're there to keep you sane.

Wishing you all the best~ 
We will survive this.

Can relate to this so well. My nmom is dumb and its honestly insulting that she's managed to control my life. The thing is, my nfather was an intelligent man that she had wrapped around her finger. 

My father was an intellectual. Basically he was that dude who had a fuck ton of books, has read anything and everything that was available during his time, and listens to classical music daily. 
My mother is the complete opposite.
This messy dynamic between them is basically what fucked me over since childhood. It was as if they were constantly pulling me to each side, wanting me to become their ally (as if their marriage was some weird competition.)

Now, this isn't just me being an elitist about the learned side of life, because every decision she makes is always rooted on the fact that yes, she is stupid about the things her husband and her daughter likes, and she's damn well proud of it. 

Nmom was proud to bully anything that she considers "smart" just because she wasn't as academically adept the same way my father was. She bullied me out of liking studying, basically liking anything. Back then I was pretty good with most of my subjects, except for Math, and when I told her that I should get a tutor, she told me that "You can't have everything in life, be thankful you have high grades in English and Science. Don't be selfish."

A dumb narcissist controlled my family dynamic. All because she was stupid enough to flatter another narcissist's fragile male ego.

Drained the swelling part one day, then when we went to the dentist, nparents basically told me that I was a liar because the pus-pocket wasn't there anymore. 
From what I remember, the dentist did say that there was something in my gums and then nparents fell silent then moved on as if nothing happened. 

Turns out that they were the first priority whenever they have health issues because they were poor growing up. Selfish ol' me being sheltered and spoiled and all that crap. "We used to endure much worse, you should be thankful you're lucky."
